questions.prompt: How many continents are there on Earth (by the seven-continent model taught in many schools)?
questions.clue: Africa and Antarctica are both counted separately in this model.
questions.explanation: The seven-continent model lists Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania/Australia, and South America.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.clue: It combines the lightest element with oxygen.
questions.explanation: Water is two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom: H₂O.

questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.clue: Its dusty surface is rich in iron oxide.
questions.explanation: Mars appears reddish due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.prompt: What is the largest ocean on Earth by area?
questions.clue: It borders Asia and the Americas and covers more than 30% of Earth's surface.
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's ocean divisions.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.clue: Think of a beehive cell.
questions.explanation: A hexagon is a six-sided polygon; honeycomb cells are hexagonal.

questions.prompt: Which gas do plants primarily absorb for photosynthesis?
questions.clue: Humans exhale the gas plants use as a carbon source.
questions.explanation: Plants take in CO₂ and release O₂ during photosynthesis.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.clue: It is one of the world's most populous metro areas and hosts the Imperial Palace.
questions.explanation: Tokyo has been Japan's capital since the late 19th century (Meiji era).

questions.prompt: Which instrument has 88 keys on a standard full-size version?
questions.clue: It spans more than seven octaves of black and white keys.
questions.explanation: A modern standard piano typically has 88 keys (52 white, 36 black).

questions.prompt: What do bees collect from flowers to make honey?
questions.clue: It is a sugary liquid produced by flowers to attract pollinators.
questions.explanation: Worker bees collect nectar and convert it into honey in the hive.

questions.prompt: Which ancient wonder was located in Alexandria, Egypt?
questions.clue: It guided ships into a famous Mediterranean harbor.
questions.explanation: The Lighthouse of Alexandria (Pharos) was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

questions.prompt: About how many days are in a non-leap year?
questions.clue: February has 28 days in these years.
questions.explanation: A common year has 365 days; leap years have 366.

questions.prompt: Roughly how many bones are in an adult human body?
questions.clue: Babies start with more; some fuse as we grow.
questions.explanation: Adults typically have 206 bones after fusion of some childhood bones.

questions.prompt: How many degrees are in a full circle?
questions.clue: A right angle is one-quarter of this.
questions.explanation: A full rotation is defined as 360 degrees in common measure.

questions.prompt: About how many meters are in a kilometer?
questions.clue: The prefix "kilo-" means thousand.
questions.explanation: 1 kilometer = 1000 meters by SI definition.

questions.prompt: Approximate boiling point of water at standard sea-level pressure (°C)?
questions.clue: Freezing is 0°C on the same scale; boiling is the other classic landmark.
questions.explanation: At 1 atm, pure water boils at about 100°C (212°F).

questions.prompt: How many minutes are in 2.5 hours?
questions.clue: Half an hour is 30 minutes.
questions.explanation: 2 hours = 120 minutes; plus 30 = 150 minutes.

questions.prompt: A dozen equals how many items?
questions.clue: Egg cartons often use this count.
questions.explanation: A dozen is a grouping of twelve.

questions.prompt: About how many teeth does a typical adult human have (including wisdom teeth)?
questions.clue: Kids have 20 baby teeth; adults gain more permanent ones.
questions.explanation: A full adult set is usually 32 teeth including four wisdom teeth.

questions.prompt: If all roses are flowers and some flowers fade quickly, which must be true?
questions.clue: "Some flowers" does not force every rose into that group.
questions.explanation: We only know roses are flowers; whether they fade quickly is possible but not guaranteed for all.

questions.prompt: What comes next: 2, 4, 8, 16, …?
questions.clue: Each term doubles.
questions.explanation: The sequence is powers of two: 2ⁿ.

questions.prompt: A farmer has 17 sheep; all but 9 run away. How many are left?
questions.clue: Read "all but 9" carefully.
questions.explanation: "All but 9" means 9 remain.

questions.prompt: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be in 10 days?
questions.clue: A week from Wednesday is Wednesday; count the extra days.
questions.explanation: 10 = 7+3, so three days after Wednesday is Saturday.

questions.prompt: Which shape has exactly three sides?
questions.clue: Its name starts with "tri-" (three).
questions.explanation: A triangle is a three-sided polygon.

questions.prompt: You have a 3-liter and a 5-liter jug. Can you measure exactly 4 liters by filling/pouring?
questions.clue: This is the water-jug puzzle from Die Hard with a Vengeance fame.
questions.explanation: By filling, emptying, and pouring between jugs you can obtain 4 liters in the 5-liter jug.

questions.prompt: All Blips are Blops. Some Blops are Blaps. Therefore:
options: None of the above must be true
questions.clue: The "some" set of Blops might not overlap Blips at all.
questions.explanation: There is no forced overlap between Blips and Blaps from the premises.

questions.prompt: If a clock shows 3:00, what is the angle between hour and minute hands?
questions.clue: At 3 o'clock the minute hand is on 12 and the hour hand on 3.
questions.explanation: Each hour mark is 30°; from 12 to 3 is 90°.

questions.prompt: Which comes first chronologically?
options: Writing a thank-you note after a party
Buying a gift on the way home
questions.clue: You need to know about the event before you go.
questions.explanation: Invitation precedes attendance and follow-up thanks.

questions.prompt: In the water cycle, which typically happens first for rain to form?
questions.clue: Water vapor must cool and form droplets before falling.
questions.explanation: Evaporated water condenses into clouds, then may precipitate as rain.

questions.prompt: Which U.S. president served earliest?
questions.clue: He was the first under the Constitution.
questions.explanation: George Washington served 1789–1797, earlier than the others listed.

questions.prompt: Put these by size (smallest first). Which is the smallest?
questions.clue: It orbits Earth and is much smaller than any planet here.
questions.explanation: The Moon's diameter is far smaller than Earth's, Jupiter's, or the Sun's.

questions.prompt: In a standard English dictionary, which word would appear first?
questions.clue: Alphabetical order starts near A.
questions.explanation: Apple begins with A, before B, M, or Z.

questions.prompt: Which event came first?
options: Invention of the World Wide Web
questions.clue: It happened in 1969, decades before the consumer internet boom.
questions.explanation: Apollo 11 landed in 1969; WWW ~1989–91; Berlin Wall 1989; iPhone 2007.

questions.prompt: Which meal is typically earliest in the day?
questions.clue: Its name literally refers to breaking a fast overnight.
questions.explanation: Breakfast is the first meal of the day for most people.

questions.prompt: What is the hardest natural substance on the Mohs scale?
questions.clue: It scores a perfect 10 and is carbon in a crystal lattice.
questions.explanation: Diamond ranks 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.

questions.prompt: Which mammal is known for laying eggs?
questions.clue: It is a monotreme found in Australia with a duck-like bill.
questions.explanation: The platypus (and echidnas) are egg-laying mammals.

questions.prompt: About how many kilometers is a marathon?
questions.clue: It is a bit over 26 miles.
questions.explanation: A marathon is 42.195 km (26.2 miles).

questions.prompt: How many players are on the field for one soccer (football) team during normal play?
questions.clue: Includes the goalkeeper.
questions.explanation: Association football fields 11 players per side including the keeper.
